headword: {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}
reading: えいようほじょしょくひん

definitions.explanation: A food product taken to supplement the diet with vitamins, minerals, or other nutrients. Built from {栄養|えいよう} (nutrition) + {補助|ほじょ} (supplementary aid) + {食品|しょくひん} (food product).

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take dietary supplements every day.

examples.japanese: {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: It's good to make up for nutrients you can't get from meals alone with dietary supplements.

notes:
The formal Japanese term for a dietary supplement, common on product labels and in health writing. In casual speech, the loanword ⟦サプリ→サプリ：30748_sapuri⟧ (or ⟦サプリメント→サプリメント：10937_sapurimento⟧) is far more frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栄養補助食品|えいようほじょしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂|と}る→摂る：29372_toru⟧: to take a dietary supplement
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧: to supplement nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サプリメント→サプリメント：10937_sapurimento⟧ / ⟦サプリ→サプリ：30748_sapuri⟧: supplement — the everyday loanword for the same thing
- ⟦{健康食品|けんこうしょくひん}→健康食品：17355_kenkoushokuhin⟧: health food — a broader category of foods marketed for health benefits
